summary:
Our project was born from the challenge of waste on Mars and the idea of finding a different way to publicize this problem. To do this, we resume the story of two little robot brothers inspired by Spirit and Opportunity, the rovers that explored Mars, and adapted it to create an obby-type game in Roblox.
Through this proposal we seek to bring players closer to the issue of space exploration, showing some of the challenges that exist in missions to Mars, especially the waste that remains after landings. The game works as an educational and recreational simulation, so its scenarios are an imaginative representation and are not based exactly on the real appearance of Mars.
We chose Roblox because we believe it is a platform that allows us to transmit information in an attractive and entertaining way, especially for children. Our purpose is for players to have fun, learn something new and understand the importance of this challenge.
details:
Our project is an educational obby created in Roblox, in which players must overcome different obstacles while accompanying two little robot brothers inspired by the Spirit and Opportunity rovers during their adventure on Mars. Throughout the game you will be able to discover interesting facts about the planet, the history of space missions and the problem of the debris found on it.

The game works as an educational simulation, with creatively designed scenarios that do not seek to represent exactly what Mars looks like in reality, but offer a fun space to learn and explore.

To develop it we use Roblox Studio, where we create the scenarios, obstacles and different elements of the game. His creativity is in transforming a scientific topic into an adventure, using characters and stories to make learning more interesting.

As a team, we agree that video games are a good tool for learning, especially for children, since many are more attracted to visual, dynamic and interactive activities. That's why we looked for our game to be entertaining, easy to understand and to keep the interest of the players while they discover something new at each level.
dataRefs: Rovers de exploración de Marte: Spirit y Opportunity
